newsitem.title: USA: Schwab in talks on sports pact - sources.
newsitem.headline: Schwab in talks on sports pact - sources.

text.p: ORLANDO, Fla., Nov 6, Reuter - Charles Schwab & Co Inc is in talks with a professional sports organization on a deal to serve as its "official" investment adviser, according to Schwab sources.
Schwab officials, attending the company's annual institutional conference in Orlando, on Wednesday declined to comment on the talks.
The deal would involve Schwab serving as the investment adviser to the group's retirement fund as well as the company using its relationship with the sports group as a marketing tool.
The talks were in the final stages, and television commercials have already been produced, the sources said.
